title: LearnAI | A Developer's Guide to Building Scalable AI: Workflows vs Agents
excerpt: Presents a structured scoring framework across five dimensions (task complexity, business value vs. volume, reliability requirements, technical readiness, organizational maturity), each awarding +2 points to either workflows or agents. A score ≥ 6 for workflows means stick with workflows; ≥ 6 for agents means agents may be viable if no workflow-critical blockers exist. Also advocates hybrid systems where workflows handle predictable high-volume tasks and agents handle complex ambiguous decisions.
